fact: A study of 20 MoHSS IT staff published in September 2025 states that the ministry still relies on paper records in most hospitals and clinics, practitioners reading patients' histories only from paper health passports and manual records; the Integrated Health Care Information Management System launched in 2011 was fully deployed only at Windhoek Central Hospital and Oshakati State Hospital, and there is no unique patient identifier.
title: Challenges In Implementing Integrated Electronic Health Records (EHRS) in Namibia's Public Health Sector
publisher: Journal of Information Systems and Informatics
